## Accepted scope

This reconstructed theoretical edition proves the determinant-divisibility assertion in [Teufl–Wagner Problem 1](https://ems.press/content/serial-article-files/46745), printed pp. 1457–1458, for every n ≥ 1: (det A)^C_n divides det T in Z[a_ij], for generic A and the full Bell-partition forest transfer matrix. It fixes one unweighted tree per input block and counts each admissible interlayer edge subset once. There is no planarity, noncrossing-state, symmetry, positivity or numerical nonzero-row-sum restriction.

The conclusion is a divisor, not exact multiplicity of det A or irreducibility of the remaining factor. The full proof constructs the constant Catalan-dimensional quotient, determines its transfer determinant exactly, lifts through the invariant kernel, and uses Gauss's lemma for integer-polynomial divisibility.

## Evidence and review

The complete 25,072-byte reconstructed proof and 14,983-byte fresh independent audit are included byte-for-byte. The audit accepts the exact present proof hash after checking all seven lemmas, normalization and signs, invariant spanning, ordered Gaussian factors, the constant kernel and integral descent. A separate full reading of the proof and audit also found no required mathematical change.

This is a newly checked reconstructed edition of the same first approach, not byte-for-byte recovery certified by an old checksum and not a new substantive research turn. The full written audit retains its supplementary finite-check discussion; no checker code, standalone fixtures, execution-result files or logs are included. The all-n conclusion rests on the written argument.

The forest algebra and Catalan/noncrossing quotient are established work of [Caracciolo–Sokal–Sportiello](https://arxiv.org/pdf/0706.1509v2) and [Sportiello’s thesis, Chapter 10](https://pcteserver.mi.infn.it/~caraccio/PhD/Sportiello.pdf). Attribution, the bounded related-work review, five freshly retrieved public PDF identities and inspection history are retained. No novelty, historical-priority or current-open-status claim is made. The reviews are AI mathematical/source audits, not human peer review or formal proof-assistant verification.

## Exact addition-only scope

Add exactly ten files under `unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30003822/`: the full proof, full fresh audit, attribution, acceptance, status and provenance, source catalogue/inspection metadata, README and noncircular manifest. No QUEUE.md or unrelated file changes.

No copied third-party source PDFs, text, HTML or images, dataset contents, private sources, derived source-text fingerprints, private inventories or private coordination material are included. File hashes and additive patch replay validate packaging integrity only.
